natural_body: Targeted 40% discounts boost acquisition but sharply damage retention.

first.rationale: I intend to test a shorter onboarding flow because onboarding completion is down 4% quarter over quarter, and prior evidence links shorter onboarding to improved time-to-value and early adoption. Activation messaging is also relevant to the 6% activation decline, so I would verify that evidence and monitor meaningful activation, qualified pipeline, and retention—not completion alone—to avoid optimizing a shallow metric.
